Name: Tree Shaker
Author: TyoAtrosa
Description:
Updated for upcoming SMAPI 4.4.0 and SDV 1.6+

Multiplayer Friendly, only one player needs to have the mod for it to work, even if the host doesn't have it.

just place a chest to the right of your mailbox (or change the chest location in the config file) and in the morning every tree seed on your farm will be picked up and placed in the chest. it's as simple as that. to stop the mod just pick the chest back up.

Added Config Options to Disable the Check for Seeds (Disabled will just give a seed for every single tree present.)
Also added a Config option to Enable picking up of Ground Seeds to prevent stray trees from spreading.

Many thanks to Pathoschild and everyone from the discord that helped me with my very first mod and foray into C#! this would have never happened without you.

Sorry for the long wait! We've been through hell!
